li.label: worked through the cold snap
li.description: The council said carry on, so we carried on in the cold. I couldn't feel my hands by noon.

li.label: left the blight alone
li.description: I found the blight, and the council let it be. I watch it walk down the rows every morning.

li.label: trusted with the good weapon
li.description: The council gave the good one to me. I mean to be worth it when it counts.

li.label: looking after their animal
li.description: Their animal is mine to look after now. It keeps close, the way it kept close to them.

li.label: a new animal to handle
li.description: An animal that lost its person, and mine to settle. It'll take patience.

li.label: their animal went to someone else
li.description: I'd have kept it close for their sake. The council gave it to someone who knows animals better.
